delete.description:
Request body: ``{"email": "<the account's email>"}`` (required). Idempotent: erasing a
user with no data succeeds, and the call can be repeated after a ``502``.

All app rows go in one transaction (with the salted email hash that makes a re-registration
with the same email start at 0 credits), then the objects under ``resumes/{user_id}/``.

502.description: ERASE_INCOMPLETE: rows are gone, some objects were not removed; retry

delete.summary: Erase every piece of app data for a user (called by Better Auth before it deletes the account)

get.description:
Contents: ``profile.json``, ``resumes/`` (original files), ``resumes.json`` (details and
extracted text), ``job_descriptions.json``, ``matches.json`` (full reports),
``generated_documents.json``, ``credit_transactions.json`` and a ``README.txt``. The ZIP is
built into a temporary file (deleted after the response) and streamed.
get.summary: Download everything you own as a ZIP (once per hour)

description it used are not touched (the n8n version deleted all three).

delete.description:
Row first, then the object: a failed object delete leaves a harmless orphan that the
startup sweep removes, never a row pointing at a missing file. Matches that used this
resume are deleted with it (foreign key cascade).

post.description:
Recruiter mode only. Credits for the whole batch are reserved up front (all or
nothing); each resume that fails is refunded individually and listed in ``failed``.
One step per resume (``score:<resume_id>``) streams progress. Job result:
``ScreeningResult`` (ranked best first).
